title: monthly_revenue.sql

spec.text: Revenue per calendar month for the last 12 full months, net of refunds. Partial refunds exist and must be subtracted. Months are in Asia/Singapore time.

context: PostgreSQL 16. orders.created_at is timestamptz. refunds(order_id, amount) can have several rows per order.

files.content:
-- Monthly revenue for the finance dashboard.
SELECT date_trunc('month', o.created_at) AS month,
       SUM(o.total)                      AS revenue,
       COUNT(*)                          AS orders
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.created_at >= now() - interval '12 months'
  AND r.id IS NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
